edits.current:
- name: Install Python for scripting HostNull acceptance
        if: matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11.16'
      - name: Install Ruby for scripting HostNull acceptance
        if: matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3.12'

- name: Qualify HostNull in prepared scripting packages
        if: matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        id: host_null_scripting
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 100
        env:
          HOST_NULL_PERL_CONFIGURATION: ${{ matrix.configuration }}
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_CORPUS_PERL="$PWD/.toolchains/perl/$HOST_NULL_PERL_CONFIGURATION/bin/perl"
          bash scripts/run-host-null-scripting-ci.sh
      - name: Preserve HostNull scripting acceptance
        if: always() && matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: host-null-scripting-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/host-null-scripting-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30

- name: Enforce scripting HostNull support
        if: always() && matrix.configuration == '5.38.2-threaded' && steps.host_null_scripting.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1
